title: She Was Not Amused
question: Why did Jenny want to leave the wedding reception?

meanings.usage: 指正式场合的宴会或聚会
表达对某人的尊敬和赞赏
指人的幽默性格或幽默的东西
指在公共场合的正式发言
修饰动词，表示做事的仔细程度
表达因期望落空而产生的情绪
表示从某事中获得乐趣
表示因感到有趣而发出笑声

phrases.usage: 指拥有很多的社交圈子，朋友很多

examples.en: He has a large circle of friends.
examples.zh: 他有很多朋友。

phrases.usage: 发表演讲，在公共场合进行正式发言

examples.en: He was asked to make a speech at the wedding.
examples.zh: 他被邀请在婚礼上发表演讲。

phrases.usage: 令他惊讶的是，表示出乎意料

examples.en: To his surprise, she refused the invitation.
examples.zh: 令他惊讶的是，她拒绝了邀请。

phrases.usage: 一...就...，表示两个动作紧接着发生

examples.en: As soon as he finished, Jenny left.
examples.zh: 他一结束，Jenny就离开了。

phrases.usage: 这类事情，某种类型的事物

examples.en: This is the sort of thing that he loves.
examples.zh: 这正是他喜欢的事情。

examples.en: He did as his daughter asked.
examples.zh: 他按照女儿的要求做了。

examples.en: They talked on the way home.
examples.zh: 他们在回家的路上交谈。

phrases.usage: 大量的，许多的，后接可数名词复数

examples.en: He told a large number of funny stories.
examples.zh: 他讲了很多有趣的故事。

examples.en: Of course, it was a great success.
examples.zh: 当然，这是一次巨大的成功。

examples.en: He was a little disappointed by this.
examples.zh: 他对这件事感到有点失望。

sentences.en: Jeremy Hampden has a large circle of friends and is very popular at parties.
sentences.zh: 杰里米·汉普顿交友甚广，在聚会上很受欢迎。

sentences.en: Everybody admires him for his great sense of humour--everybody, that is, except his six-year-old daughter, Jenny.
sentences.zh: 人人都羡慕他那绝妙的幽默感——人人都羡慕，除了他六岁的女儿珍妮。

sentences.en: Recently, one of Jeremy's closest friends asked him to make a speech at a wedding reception.
sentences.zh: 最近，杰里米的一位最亲密的朋友请他在一个婚宴上讲话。

sentences.en: This is the sort of thing that Jeremy loves.
sentences.zh: 这正是杰里米喜欢做的事情。

sentences.en: He prepared the speech carefully and went to the wedding with Jenny.
sentences.zh: 他精心准备了演讲稿，并和珍妮一起去了婚礼。

sentences.en: He had included a large number of funny stories in the speech and, of course, it was a great success.
sentences.zh: 他在演讲中讲了许多有趣的故事，当然，演讲非常成功。

sentences.en: As soon as he had finished Jenny told him she wanted to go home.
sentences.zh: 演讲刚一结束，珍妮就告诉他她想回家。

sentences.en: Jeremy was a little disappointed by this but he did as his daughter asked.
sentences.zh: 杰里米对此有点失望，但他还是照他女儿的要求做了。

sentences.en: On the way home, he asked Jenny if she had enjoyed the speech.
sentences.zh: 在回家的路上，他问珍妮是否喜欢那个演讲。

sentences.en: To his surprise she said she hadn't.
sentences.zh: 令他惊讶的是，她说她不喜欢。

sentences.en: Jeremy asked her why this was so and she told him that she did not like to see so many people laughing at him!
sentences.zh: 杰里米问她为什么不喜欢，她告诉他她不喜欢看到那么多人嘲笑他！

exercises.explain: speech · /spiːtʃ/ · noun · 演讲；发言。指在公共场合的正式发言

exercises.prompt: 根据释义和音标拼写单词：笑；大笑
exercises.explain: laugh · /lɑːf/ · verb · 笑；大笑。表示因感到有趣而发出笑声

exercises.prompt: 补全短语：_____, she refused the invitation.
exercises.hint: 令他惊讶的是，她拒绝了邀请。
exercises.explain: to his surprise：令他惊讶的是，表示出乎意料（令他惊讶的是，她拒绝了邀请。）

exercises.prompt: 补全句子：He _____ the speech carefully and went to the wedding with Jenny.
exercises.hint: 他精心准备了演讲稿，并和珍妮一起去了婚礼。
exercises.explain: He prepared the speech carefully and went to the wedding with Jenny. — 他精心准备了演讲稿，并和珍妮一起去了婚礼。

source.en: He prepared the speech carefully and went to the wedding with Jenny.

exercises.prompt: “当转述别人的话时，可以使用直接引用原话，或将原话转换为转述句。间接引语中，人称、时态、时间状语等通常需要相应变化。” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: 主句 + 连词 + 主语 + 动词 + 其他成分；人称变化：第一人称→第二人称，第二人称→第一人称；时态后退（过去时→过去完成时等）
options: 直接引语和间接引语（Direct and Indirect Speech）
exercises.explain: 直接引语和间接引语（Direct and Indirect Speech）：主句 + 连词 + 主语 + 动词 + 其他成分；人称变化：第一人称→第二人称，第二人称→第一人称；时态后退（过去时→过去完成时等）：用于转述他人说过的话，使叙述更加流畅自然。在口语和书面语中都常用。

source.title: 直接引语和间接引语（Direct and Indirect Speech）

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：
He had included a large number of funny stories in the speech and, of course, it was a great success.
options: 哈里森把什么都考虑到了，就是没想到天气。
他在演讲中讲了许多有趣的故事，当然，演讲非常成功。
exercises.explain: He had included a large number of funny stories in the speech and, of course, it was a great success. — 他在演讲中讲了许多有趣的故事，当然，演讲非常成功。

source.en: He had included a large number of funny stories in the speech and, of course, it was a great success.

grammar.title: 直接引语和间接引语（Direct and Indirect Speech）
grammar.definition: 当转述别人的话时，可以使用直接引用原话，或将原话转换为转述句。间接引语中，人称、时态、时间状语等通常需要相应变化。
grammar.structure: 主句 + 连词 + 主语 + 动词 + 其他成分；人称变化：第一人称→第二人称，第二人称→第一人称；时态后退（过去时→过去完成时等）
grammar.usage: 用于转述他人说过的话，使叙述更加流畅自然。在口语和书面语中都常用。

examples.en: She said she hadn't enjoyed the speech.
examples.zh: 她说她不喜欢那个演讲。

examples.en: He asked her why she hadn't enjoyed it.
examples.zh: 他问她为什么不喜欢。

examples.en: She told him that she did not like to see so many people laughing at him.
examples.zh: 她告诉他她不喜欢看到那么多人在笑他。

grammar.title: as soon as 的用法
grammar.definition: 连词词组，表示'一...就...'，强调两个动作紧接着发生。
grammar.structure: as soon as + 主语 + 动词...，主句
grammar.usage: 用于描述先后发生的两个动作，第一个动作一发生，第二个动作立即开始。常用于叙述故事的发展。

examples.en: As soon as he had finished, Jenny told him she wanted to go home.
examples.zh: 他一讲完，Jenny就告诉他她想回家。

examples.en: As soon as I arrived, I called my mother.
examples.zh: 我一到达就给我妈妈打了电话。

grammar.title: 过去完成时（Past Perfect Tense）
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻之前已经完成的动作或状态。由had + 过去分词构成。
grammar.structure: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.usage: 用于描述过去的过去，即两个过去的动作中，先发生的动作用过去完成时。当after, as soon as等连词引导时间状语从句时，主句用过去完成时，从句用一般过去时。

examples.en: As soon as he had finished, Jenny told him...
examples.zh: 他一讲完，Jenny就告诉他...

examples.en: He had included a large number of funny stories in the speech.
examples.zh: 他在演讲中加入了大量有趣的故事。

patterns.pattern: Everybody admires him for his + 名词

original.en: Everybody admires him for his great sense of humour.
original.zh: 每个人都钦佩他的幽默感。

examples.en: Everybody admires her for her kindness.
examples.zh: 每个人都钦佩她的善良。

examples.en: We admire him for his courage.
examples.zh: 我们钦佩他的勇气。

patterns.pattern: To his + 情绪名词, she + 动词过去式

original.en: To his surprise, she said she hadn't.
original.zh: 令他惊讶的是，她说她没有（喜欢）。

examples.en: To his disappointment, he failed the exam.
examples.zh: 令他失望的是，他考试不及格。

examples.en: To her surprise, everyone agreed with her.
examples.zh: 令她惊讶的是，每个人都同意她的观点。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + asked + 宾语 + if/why/what + 陈述句/疑问句

original.en: He asked her why this was so.

examples.en: She asked him if he was tired.
examples.zh: 她问他是否累了。

examples.en: They asked me why I was late.
examples.zh: 他们问我为什么迟到。

patterns.pattern: This is the sort of thing that + 主语 + loves/hates

original.en: This is the sort of thing that Jeremy loves.

examples.en: This is the sort of thing that she hates.
examples.zh: 这正是她讨厌的事情。

examples.en: That is the sort of book that I enjoy.
examples.zh: 那正是我喜欢的那种书。
